    The k-dual of a finite-dimensional module #

    For a finite-dimensional A-module M, the dual D M = Hom_k(M, k) is an Aᵐᵒᵖ-module by precomposition (dualOp), and for an Aᵐᵒᵖ-module N the dual is an A-module (dualUnop). Evaluation identifies M with D (D M) (evEquiv), A-linearly.
